name: LDL receptor related protein 1

function.text: LRP1 is the approved symbol for LDL receptor related protein 1. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in alpha-2 macroglobulin receptor activity; amyloid-beta binding; amyloid-beta clearance.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Papillary renal cell carcinoma; Prostate adenocarcinoma; Cutaneous melanoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Historical hotspot cohort observation; individual-allele significance and tumor-specific oncogenicity require review.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving LRP1 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma, prostate adenocarcinoma, and papillary renal cell carcinoma.
